from pathlib import Path
jpg=Path('/workspace/pocs/img.jpg').read_bytes()
# truncate EOI? try full first
pdf = b'%PDF-1.3\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n'
off=[]
def obj(n,s):
    off.append(len(pdf_parts[0])); pdf_parts[0]+=f'{n} 0 obj\n'.encode()+s+b'\nendobj\n'
pdf_parts=[pdf]
obj(1,b'<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>')
obj(2,b'<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>')
obj(3,b'<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 8 24] /Resources << /XObject << /Im0 4 0 R >> >> /Contents 5 0 R >>')
stream_dict=f'<< /Type /XObject /Subtype /Image /Width 8 /Height 24 /ColorSpace /DeviceRGB /BitsPerComponent 8 /Filter /DCTDecode /Length {len(jpg)} >>'.encode()
obj(4,stream_dict+b'\nstream\n'+jpg+b'\nendstream')
content=b'q 8 0 0 24 0 0 cm /Im0 Do Q\n'
obj(5,f'<< /Length {len(content)} >>'.encode()+b'\nstream\n'+content+b'endstream')
xref_pos=len(pdf_parts[0])
pdf_parts[0]+=f'xref\n0 6\n0000000000 65535 f \n'.encode()
for o in off:
    pdf_parts[0]+=f'{o:010d} 00000 n \n'.encode()
pdf_parts[0]+=f'trailer << /Root 1 0 R /Size 6 >>\nstartxref\n{xref_pos}\n%%EOF\n'.encode()
Path('/workspace/pocs/poc1.pdf').write_bytes(pdf_parts[0])
print(len(jpg), len(pdf_parts[0]))
